Useful boundary
Water-to-delivered dry pressurizedH2 is a full operation including electrodes/carrier, gas acceptance, drying/compression, thermal state, preparation, replacement and shutdown. The underlying complete-ammonia ledger is not a demonstration of a new hydrogen module.
In the available conditional ammonia design,11.5->10kWh/kg saves only0.075USD/kg at0.05USD/kWh. Waiving its0.505USD/kg initial capital recovery leaves0.998USD/kg with its other costs unchanged; capital is therefore material, but no free factory/life follows.

Actually read component precedent
The initial main pp786--789 of Dotan etal2019 E-TAC, DOI10.1038/s41560-019-0462-7, describe cobalt-doped nickel-hydroxide electrochemical charging with hydrogen evolution and hotter chemical regeneration with oxygen release. Small100s/100s cycles used ambient/95C alkaline baths and a platinized benchmark cathode. Reported low cell work is electrical-only. This supplies a real separated-reaction operation, not complete heat recovery, pressurized gas handling, lifetime or plant cost.

ROOT ORE-CONTACT RENEWAL AND ISOTHERMAL REDOX-REGENERATION CONTRACTS
12 November 2026 Brisbane / UTC
Conditional physical designs and arithmetic; no apparatus, supplier quote, lifetime qualification or full-system advantage is established.

1. Actual distinct source exposure
Maihatchi et al., J. Electrochem. Sci. Eng.10(2)(2020)95--102, DOI10.5599/jese.751, exact https://hrcak.srce.hr/file/342165 : main Experimental, Results and Discussion/Conclusion through p102 read. The 0.8L stirred, externally thermostated, nitrogen-swept cell used a19.4cm2 graphite cathode/Ti-Pt grid,110C/12.5MNaOH. Actual tested red mud performed very differently from commercial hematite. Particle-surface inhibition is a proposed explanation; the suggested cancrinite/sodalite coating was not directly evidenced. Dissolved-impurity cleaning cannot be assumed to restore ore contact. No cited original, SI or linked artifact was followed.

Landman et al., Nature Materials2017, DOI10.1038/nmat4876, author arXiv2012.04441v1, exact https://arxiv.org/pdf/2012.04441v1 : main results and Methods through pp16--17 read. Commercial Ni-hydroxide auxiliary electrodes mediated two separate ambient1MNaOH cells; initial activation, switching and charge drift matter. The125h case reported2.12V mean/0.12V auxiliary-pair loss. Higher-current Methods used Ir/Ti and Pt/Ti and unequal electrode areas. Gas results do not supply a5ppm detection limit,30bar operation, complete cost or lifetime. The mechanism is credited prior art, not a new invention. No cited original/SI was followed.

2. Ore-to-metal: simultaneous requirements
The complete AVAILABLE ore design has an accounted feed and conditional harvesting/washing/guard process. Its5.592MWh/t energy and684USD/t at40USD/MWh are engineering-model premises, not measurements. Of that energy4.709MWh/t is cell/rectifier and0.883 is other declared supply energy.
With declared3e/Fe Faraday charge q=1439.7787Ah/kg and an INTRODUCED.95rectifier, a4MWh/t whole budget retaining those other loads permits V/FE<=2.05667V. At.66FE this is1.3574V; at.90FE it is1.8510V. Improving voltage without iron selectivity is insufficient.
An INTRODUCED jointly-unmeasured1.7V/.90FE point gives2.86272MWh/t cell and3.74572 total with the old other loads. Even simultaneously waiving ALL32.2lime+28.5caustic+3.9acid+45.8waste/waterUSD/t and crediting that electrical saving leaves499.75USD/t.

Hydrogen redox, gas and pressure closure contracts
ROOT independent conditional engineering work,12November2026Brisbane

Operation and scope
The useful output is accepted dry30bar hydrogen, not gross cathodic gas. This note develops an optional circulating one-electron nickel-hydroxide carrier interface and a closed loss/energy ledger. It does not assume that any ongoing design uses that architecture. Stationary alkaline/AEM/PEM electrodes and other mechanisms do not inherit the moving-carrier costs automatically.
Existing small E-TAC component passages and the earlier ROOT heat/service note supply a reason to examine the interface, not its solution. No new source navigation, held-paper recovery, producer execution or physical experiment was performed. This is not an established hydrogen invention, measured device, life qualification, price or all-architecture obstruction.

Disjoint redox and gas inventories
Use declared M_H2=.00201588kg/mol, M_Ni(OH)2=.09270808kg/mol, F=96485.33212C/mol and ideal-gas R=8.314462618J/mol/K. These are analytic constants, not recovered H2 thermochemical data.
For one kg GROSS cathodic H2, n=1/M_H2 and the one-electron carrier throughput is M=2*M_Ni(OH)2/(M_H2*u). At introduced working conversion u=.1 this is919.7778kg active material cycled/kg grossH2. This is throughput, not simultaneously installed inventory.
Let f be the fraction of all returning carrier sites that remains oxidized after thermal oxygen regeneration AND is subsequently reduced by contact with productH2. Reaction 2NiOOH+H2 ->2Ni(OH)2 consumes fraction f/u of grossH2. This loss requires actual contact/kinetics; it is not inferred from an electrode potential alone. If that oxidized stock never contactsH2 or is separately regenerated, this particular product loss changes.
A trace-O2 analyzer does not measure this solid oxidizing inventory. Conversely, incomplete regeneration retained in a stationary cyclic state is not automatically an ever-growing product loss. Track incoming and outgoing states and the actual reduction path.
Returning free/dissolved O2 is a separate inventory: each mole removed by catalytic deoxygenation consumes two molesH2 and forms two moleswater. Its catalyst, exotherm, cooling, water removal and service are separate duties. The present utility allowance does not establish them.
